_about: Substat priorities per Resonator, copied from the build guides on 2026-10-14 (wuwabuild.com, which mirrors prydwen.gg; Rover forms and Jinhsi from prydwen.gg). make_roster.py turns these into roster.json weights. Characters listed under 'keep' already have hand-reviewed weights in roster.json and are left as they are.

keep_notes.Calcharo: Main DPS · Crit Rate/DMG + ATK%, then Liberation DMG
keep_notes.Hiyuki: Main DPS · Crit first, then ATK%, then Liberation DMG (almost all her damage counts as Liberation) · ER ~120-130%
keep_notes.Mortefi: Sub-DPS · ER for uptime, ATK%/Crit and Liberation DMG for his burst
keep_notes.Shorekeeper: Healer · ER to ~230-250% first, then Crit DMG and Liberation DMG
keep_notes.Verina: Healer · ER ~180-220%, never Crit or damage substats
keep_notes.Yinlin: Sub-DPS · Crit matters more without her signature weapon; keep ER comfortable for Liberation
